summary: Asks the Nashville Department of Transportation and Multimodal Infrastructure and Metro Parks to review injuries and safety measures at greenway crosswalks and street crossings, and to give cost estimates for improvements. It also asks them to fix urgent problem spots within three months and report to the Council within six months.

judge.problem: The resolution asks the departments to determine which crossings are urgent concerns and implement intervention tools at them within three months. The summary says only 'fix urgent problem spots within three months', which drops the step of identifying them first. It also leaves out that the review covers injuries from the prior twelve months. The core deadline claim is supported, but 'fix' overstates 'implement intervention tools'.
